description: This file contains unit tests for puzzle utilities and related functions in a chess platform. It tests functions for parsing FEN strings, move validation, rating updates, daily puzzle selection, and puzzle pack validation.

methods.name: buildPuzzleStateFromFen
methods.description: Parses a FEN string and returns the puzzle state, including position and side to move.

methods.name: checkPuzzleUserMove
methods.description: Checks the user's move against the list of solution moves, supports alternatives.

methods.name: computeRatedRunUpdate
methods.description: Calculates the new rating after a puzzle attempt, bounded and with sensible direction.

methods.name: selectDailyPuzzleId
methods.description: Selects a deterministic daily puzzle ID based on the date.

methods.name: validatePuzzlePackJson
methods.description: Validates puzzle pack JSON schema and content.

methods.name: makeMoveFromTo
methods.description: Creates a move object given a position and source and target squares.
